issues.on_page: Grants and Loans 36,813.45 (ARPA Fund column; Statement of Activities p5 'Grants', not State Receipts)
issues.issue: No grantor printed on the line; federal is inferred from the ARPA fund name (marked computed). The FY2022/FY2023 ruling (2026-11-12) puts grant lines with no printed grantor in category other / detail Grants. Also a mixed 'Grants and Loans' label. Same applies to detail[22] (p14).

issues.on_page: Use Fees 115,904.05 = Pool and Park 8,029.68 + Water 68,447.58 + Sewer 39,426.79
issues.issue: Includes the Pool and Park Fund's use fees (8,029.68, Recreation Fees in detail[56]). Utility Charges covers about 93% of the line.

issues.on_page: Personal Services 29,168.30 (Pool and Park Fund column only)
issues.issue: The whole amount is Pool and Park (culture/recreation), not a utility. The same goes for disbursements[24] 'Professional' 1,530.00 (Pool and Park only) and part of Supplies, Repairs and Utilities. Detail tags these lines culture/recreation.

issues.on_page: Professional Services 72,670.52 = General 6,837.97 + Street 15,200.00 + Fire 1,083.60 + ARPA 49,548.95
issues.issue: The statement lists governmental spending by object only. Function comes from the dominant fund, which is a judgment call. Repair and Maintenance 104,757.36, Utilities 13,170.61, Propane 10,073.95 and Supplies 3,714.04 are mixed across funds too.
